meta.title: Advanced English Grammar Diagnostics: Indonesia
meta.description: C2+/Near-native grammar error-correction test focused on Indonesian government, economy, and public satisfaction topics.

questions.question: Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form.

multiErrorSegments.text: its fiscal report earlier than expected,

details_explanation.explanation: Use the past participle after 'having'. 'Projections' is plural, so it takes 'were'.
details_explanation.bahasa: Gunakan past participle setelah 'having'. Karena 'projections' jamak, kata kerjanya harus 'were'.
details_explanation.introduction: This question combines participle clauses and subject-verb agreement.

rules.title: Perfect participle
rules.explanation: Having + past participle expresses a completed earlier action.

questions.question: Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form.

multiErrorSegments.text: such intense scrutiny before the audit findings were released.

details_explanation.explanation: Negative adverbials at the beginning trigger inversion.
details_explanation.bahasa: Keterangan negatif di awal kalimat memerlukan inversi.

questions.question: Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form.

correctAnswers: the inflation rate to have remained

multiErrorSegments.text: at that level, consumer confidence would have deteriorated further.

details_explanation.explanation: Inverted conditionals use 'were + subject + to + verb'.
details_explanation.bahasa: Conditional inversion menggunakan pola 'were + subject + to + verb'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form.

multiErrorSegments.text: foreign investment, but they also improved public trust.

details_explanation.explanation: Not only at the start requires inversion.
details_explanation.bahasa: Frasa 'Not only' di awal memerlukan inversi.

questions.question: Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form.

details_explanation.explanation: Mandative subjunctive takes the base verb.
details_explanation.bahasa: Subjunctive setelah recommendation menggunakan bentuk dasar kata kerja.

questions.question: Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form.

multiErrorSegments.text: the unemployment figures had been announced
correctAnswers: had the unemployment figures been announced

details_explanation.explanation: No sooner requires inversion with 'had'.
details_explanation.bahasa: No sooner memerlukan inversi memakai 'had'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form.

multiErrorSegments.text: from rural provinces, indicated rising satisfaction.

details_explanation.explanation: The pronoun 'them' refers to plural results.
details_explanation.bahasa: 'Them' merujuk pada bentuk jamak sehingga harus memakai 'were'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form.

multiErrorSegments.text: the ministry informed earlier the public
correctAnswers: the ministry informed the public earlier

multiErrorSegments.text: the controversy might have been avoided.

details_explanation.explanation: The adverb naturally follows the object here.
details_explanation.bahasa: Penempatan adverb lebih tepat setelah objek pada struktur ini.

questions.question: Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form.

multiErrorSegments.text: the administration remains committed to fiscal discipline.

details_explanation.explanation: The sentence is already correct.
details_explanation.bahasa: Kalimat sudah benar. 'Whatever be the outcome' adalah bentuk formal yang sah.

questions.question: Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form.

multiErrorSegments.text: the stimulus measures, GDP would not recovered
correctAnswers: the stimulus measures, GDP would not have recovered

details_explanation.explanation: Third conditional requires 'would have + past participle'.
details_explanation.bahasa: Third conditional menggunakan 'would have + V3'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form.

multiErrorSegments.text: by independent experts, was eventually adopted.

details_explanation.explanation: Passive meaning requires 'having been scrutinized'.
details_explanation.bahasa: Makna pasif memerlukan bentuk 'having been scrutinized'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form.

details_explanation.explanation: Scarcely at sentence start triggers inversion.
details_explanation.bahasa: Scarcely di awal kalimat memerlukan inversi.

questions.question: Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form.

details_explanation.explanation: Use the mandative subjunctive after 'insist'.
details_explanation.bahasa: Setelah 'insist', gunakan subjunctive bentuk dasar.

questions.question: Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form.

multiErrorSegments.text: how significant the reform would become.

details_explanation.explanation: Fronted negative expressions require inversion.
details_explanation.bahasa: Ekspresi negatif di depan kalimat memerlukan inversi.

questions.question: Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form.

correctAnswers: the crisis had already been resolved

details_explanation.explanation: Hypothetical situations require subjunctive or past perfect forms.
details_explanation.bahasa: Situasi hipotetis memerlukan subjunctive atau past perfect.

questions.question: Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form.

details_explanation.explanation: Formal emphasis requires inversion after fronted 'so + adjective'.
details_explanation.bahasa: Penekanan formal membutuhkan inversi setelah 'so + adjective'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form.

multiErrorSegments.text: none of which was independently verified
correctAnswers: none of which were independently verified

details_explanation.explanation: The antecedent is plural ('statistics').
details_explanation.bahasa: Antecedent 'statistics' berbentuk jamak sehingga memakai 'were'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form.

multiErrorSegments.text: the review was completed did officials realized
correctAnswers: the review was completed did officials realize

details_explanation.explanation: After auxiliary 'did', use the base verb.
details_explanation.bahasa: Setelah 'did', gunakan bentuk dasar kata kerja.

questions.question: Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form.

details_explanation.explanation: The sentence is grammatically correct.
details_explanation.bahasa: Kalimat sudah benar. Ini merupakan concessive inversion yang valid.

questions.question: Click the incorrect parts and type the correct form.

multiErrorSegments.text: acted more decisively, not only market volatility would have decreased
correctAnswers: acted more decisively, not only would market volatility have decreased

multiErrorSegments.text: but investor confidence would also have recovered sooner.

details_explanation.explanation: Not only in this structure requires inversion: 'would market volatility have decreased'.
details_explanation.bahasa: Pada struktur ini, 'not only' memerlukan inversi: 'would market volatility have decreased'.
details_explanation.introduction: Combines conditional inversion and correlative inversion, a very advanced structure.
